question: What is the meaning of geometry in relation to revision of the original design?
description: Geometry plays a crucial role in the revision of the original design during construction. It is influenced by unexpected site conditions, material availability, customer needs, and cost control. These revisions may involve adjustments to material specifications, structural modifications, and layout alterations to better meet practical needs or updated regulations. The original design is revised based on these factors, and geometry is a key aspect of these revisions.
